message: So the other night, I was cooking dinner and got a little too caught up in my favorite show. You know how it goes! Suddenly, I smell smoke and remember my smoke alarms. I thought to myself, "Well, for once, I’m the prepared one!" I had just checked the batteries and even had our escape plan fresh in my mind. 😅 It felt good to know I was ready, but it also made me realize how important it is to keep those safety measures in check. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately?
